QUOTE: "A layer that was never built does not downgrade a single-token verdict. The code says this was tried and reverted, because most indexes lacking a layer were built without one and the hedge would fire on nearly every reply. The file-docs check is the one exception."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the file-docs check is the single exception to downgrading on an absent layer. It says this is deliberate, because downgrading on every absent layer would make the hedge fire on nearly every reply.
